command:
set -euo pipefail
F=buehne.html
echo '=== SUBJECT ==='; sha256sum "$F"
echo '=== SCHEDULERS ==='
grep -nE 'requestAnimationFrame|cancelAnimationFrame|setInterval|clearInterval|setTimeout|clearTimeout|Animation|animation:|transition:' "$F" | head -220 || true
echo '=== MAIN LOOP CONTEXT ==='
grep -n -B8 -A18 -E 'requestAnimationFrame\(schleife|function schleife|const schleife|let schleife' "$F" | head -180 || true
echo '=== SPECIAL CONTEXT ==='
grep -n -B8 -A30 -E 'function sonderausdruckZeigen|sonderausdruckZeigen[[:space:]]*=' "$F" | head -180 || true
echo 'SCOPE=REAL_HOST_READ_ONLY_EYE_FREEZE_SCHEDULER_FORENSICS'
